$comment: Named Seedling probe batteries for .github/workflows/seedling-probe.yml (input battery=<name>): one CI job per entry, each with ITS OWN args, each run in full. Read and validated by seedlingProbeBatteries.js (vitest: every probe exists, every flag is one the probe parses, no duplicate ids). --host is set by the job and refused here. `standard` gates every landing. `long` is dispatched by hand only (model/rules landings, fidelity A/Bs; no schedule): logical-links B walked on past standard's 900 s, with a budget MEASURED to reach the walk's next named refusal (§5.128: L39 Totem Part 72,40 at +1039–1054 s on CI, so 1200 s).
